tasks.spec:
You are building v62 of a LIVE patient-facing Bland SMS booking pathway for MK2 Optical (an optometry store; the pathway texts recall patients and books one eye exam). Work only in your current working directory. ./source is read-only reference material: v61_graph.json (the live 41-node graph), build_v61.py (its generator), scenarios.py (30-scenario suite), check_candidate_gate.py (deterministic gate), redproof_run.py (mutation prover), SPEC-v62.md (the frozen v62 spec — READ IT FIRST AND FOLLOW IT EXACTLY), and three design reviews (report-codex.md, report-grok.md, report-kimi.md) whose consensus the spec encodes. Never modify ./source. Do not load skills, call MCP/Apps, or make network calls. Do not git commit.

DELIVERABLES (all in the task directory root):
1. build_v62.py — evolve build_v61.py (keep its structure, helper functions, and comment discipline); running `python3 build_v62.py` must write v62_graph.json deterministically.
2. v62_graph.json — the generated graph, byte-consistent with what build_v62.py produces.
3. scenarios.py — the v61 suite plus the ~12 new scenarios named in SPEC-v62.md, with the 2 stale '855' expectations updated; total >= 40 entries, same structure as the v61 file.
4. check_candidate_gate.py — the v61 gate plus new rules G1-G6 from SPEC-v62.md. Interface contract: `python3 check_candidate_gate.py <graph.json>` exits 0 on pass, nonzero on fail, printing WHY for each failure. It must pass v62_graph.json and FAIL source/v61_graph.json.
5. redproof_run.py — the v61 mutations plus M1-M7 from SPEC-v62.md. Interface contract: `python3 redproof_run.py` run in a directory containing build_v62.py and check_candidate_gate.py exits 0 and prints `mutations_caught=N` (expect N >= 15; every mutation must make the gate fail for the intended reason).
6. report.md — what changed and why, any spec deviation with justification, the PROPOSED Chinese renderings of the two mandated lines clearly marked for sign-off, and anything you could not verify.

THE CHANGE (normative summary; SPEC-v62.md controls where they differ):
- Replace (855) 750-6688 with (212) 219-2219 in all eleven carrier nodes: n_confirm, n_office, n_faq, e_safe_identity, e_safe_failure, e_booking_failed, e_office, e_declined, e_stop, e_not_me, e_existing. Otherwise byte-identical text except as below.
- BRAND (Ankit decision): every 'Mott Optical' in patient-facing prompt/text becomes 'MK2 Optical'. Internal identifiers unchanged: gateway URL, secret reference, request_data fields, node ids, comments may keep Mott. Do not invent a third name variant.
- n_confirm: its message must END with, verbatim: "You're all set. If you have further questions, please call MK2 Optical at (212) 219-2219" — single bubble, no duplicated 'all set' phrasing, still names the booked time, still the ONLY node allowed a positive booking claim. The change/cancel/move clause now defers: any further patient request after confirmation routes to e_defer (below), never to n_office. Include a fixed Chinese form of the close in the prompt for Chinese-language threads, marked in report.md for sign-off; digits stay ASCII.
- New End Call node e_defer: text verbatim "For that you'll have to contact the MK2 Optical office at (212) 219-2219", outcome deferred_after_booking (add to analysis_options), tag like the other End nodes, NO outgoing edges.
- n_confirm edges: 'change requested after confirmation' retargets n_office -> e_defer; add 'anything else requested after booking' -> e_defer; keep 'confirmation delivered' -> e_booked and '72-hour silence after booking' -> e_booked. Final adjacency of n_confirm is exactly {e_booked, e_defer}.
- e_booked text stays "Thank you. We look forward to seeing you." — the gate forbids claims there; do NOT move the close into it.
- n_identity: add responseData mapping booked_already <- $.result.campaign_booked and responsePathway ["booked_already", "==", "true", -> e_defer] ORDERED BEFORE ["count", "==", "1", -> n_ask], plus the matching edge. Absent/malformed flag must fall through to existing routes (status quo).
- Global label scoping: n_office and n_faq globalLabels gain wording that they do not apply once a booking is confirmed; e_existing's label is tightened to appointments made outside this conversation.
- Preserve untouched: NO_CLAIM discipline elsewhere, NO_LEAK, NO_PRICE, LANG_REPLY/opener-only Chinese invite, STOP and wrong-person suppression paths and webhooks, all search/offer/verify/book routing, the 72-hour silence behavior, e_timeout.

HONESTY RULES: derive every preserved line from source/v61_graph.json byte-for-byte; never paraphrase mandated copy; if a spec item cannot be implemented exactly, implement the closest safe version and flag the deviation prominently in report.md rather than silently improvising. Your work is verified by an external checker that independently asserts the structural rules, reruns your builder, runs your gate against BOTH graphs, and runs your redproof — a green result you obtained by weakening the gate will be caught by the v61-must-fail check.
tasks.verified: Structural rules G1-G6 hold on v62_graph.json independently of worker code; build_v62.py reproduces the graph; the worker gate passes v62 and fails v61; redproof catches >= 15 mutations; scenarios >= 40 with no stale 855.
